forecasts.claim: China will remain on schedule with its nuclear plant build-up during 2011.
forecasts.source: China State Council suspended new nuclear project approvals, 16 March 2011, after Fukushima

forecasts.claim: China will announce in 2011 a raised 2020 nuclear capacity goal above 112 GWe.
forecasts.source: China nuclear policy after Fukushima; 2020 target later set at about 58 GW operating plus 30 GW under construction (State Council, Oct 2012)

forecasts.claim: Iran will not produce a nuclear bomb in 2011.
forecasts.source: IAEA Board of Governors report on Iran, November 2011; no Iranian nuclear weapon or test

forecasts.claim: North Korea will not be involved in a war in 2011.
forecasts.source: No inter-state war involving North Korea in 2011 (post-Yeonpyeong shelling of Nov 2010 did not escalate)

forecasts.claim: A second season of High School of the Dead will be announced or aired in 2011.
forecasts.source: Only a one-episode OVA (Drifters of the Dead, 2011) was released; no second season
forecasts.search: High School of the Dead season 2

forecasts.claim: SpaceX will successfully complete orbit-matching and docking with the International Space Station in 2011.
forecasts.source: Dragon first berthed to ISS on 25 May 2012 (COTS Demo 2/3, NASA)

forecasts.claim: SpaceX will make the first flight of its Falcon 1e rocket in 2011.
forecasts.source: Falcon 1e never flew; Falcon 1 was retired after its 2009 flight

forecasts.claim: The Gillard-led governing coalition in Australia will remain in power through 2011.
forecasts.source: Gillard Labor minority government remained in office through 2011 (Australian Parliament / AEC; next election Sept 2013)

forecasts.claim: Amazon will reach a market capitalization of $1 trillion before the end of 2020.
forecasts.source: CNBC, 4 Sept 2018: Amazon becomes second US company to hit $1 trillion market value

forecasts.claim: The US unemployment rate will not meet or exceed 10.0% in any month of 2025.
forecasts.source: BLS/FRED UNRATE monthly 2025, peak around 4.4 to 4.6%

forecasts.claim: Google Maps will still be operating (not shut down) in May 2018.
forecasts.p_text: gives it 87% odds of surviving to May 2018
forecasts.source: Google Maps remained live and widely used throughout 2018 (maps.google.com)

forecasts.claim: Within a decade of September 2012, most new cars sold in Norway will be electric.
forecasts.source: OFV / Norwegian Road Federation: battery-electric cars were 54.3% of new Norwegian car registrations in 2020, 64.5% in 2021
forecasts.search: Norway electric cars majority new sales
